name: bitmovin-observability-ad-report
description: Portable Bitmovin ad operations report skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Build a snapshot ad ops report for a Bitmovin Analytics license
interface.longDescription: Produces a snapshot-style ad operations report for a Bitmovin Analytics license. Builds the impression→start→quartile→completion funnel, ranks advertisers and ad systems, flags VAST and ad-server errors, evaluates pod-position cohorts, and summarizes ad startup latency as structured anomaly flags, returning a single AdOpsReport object.
defaultPrompt: Build an ad ops report for this Bitmovin license
Show me the VAST error breakdown for last week
How are our ads doing — funnel and advertiser performance
